title: Check: Round Robin and Least Connections

questions.prompt: Round robin is perfectly fair only if every request costs the same and every server is equally fast.
With weights A=5, B=1, C=1, what share of requests does A get?
Which sequence does smooth weighted round robin produce for A=5, B=1, C=1?
options: A, A, A, A, A, B, C
A, A, B, A, C, A, A
A, B, C, A, B, C, A
B, C, A, A, A, A, A

questions.prompt: In smooth weighted round robin, after choosing the server with the highest score, what happens to its score?
options: The total weight is subtracted from it

questions.prompt: One server has a long garbage collection pause. Which algorithm notices and steers around it?
Which algorithm sends each request to the backend with the fewest active requests? (two words)
What does least connections cost compared with round robin?
options: State: counting active requests per backend, which is hard to share across many balancers
